Amsler Surface

Amsler Surface is a surface of constant negative Gaussian curvature, given by a parametrisation, self-intersecting.

Definition

No chart is stored: defined through a Painleve III ODE that the builder integrates with RK4; no closed form exists. The shipped implementation is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.
